events.summary: Julius, Luisa and Hana discover an iguana immune to a cell mutation; a trial subject instead grows an iguana tail, revealing grafting.
events.quote: the subject instead grew an iguana tail

events.summary: Julius undergoes the procedure to get wings, then opens it to students.
events.quote: he undertook the procedure himself to get a pair of wings

events.summary: The university becomes a commune that grows into Crossbreed Labs.
events.quote: a commune that would grow into Crossbread Labs

events.summary: After adding dinosaur DNA, Julius Jameson changes his name to Jumblemorph.
events.quote: he chose to change his name and became Dr. Julius Jumblemorph
